en.quote: And the damsel's father shall say unto the elders, I gave my daughter unto this man to wife, and he hateth her; And, lo, he hath given occasions of speech against her, saying, I found not thy daughter a maid; and yet these are the tokens of my daughter's virginity. And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.
en.riddle: I gave my daughter unto this man to wife, and he hateth her
en.speaker: the damsel's father shall say unto the elders: 'I gave my daughter unto this man to wife, and he hateth her

he.quote: וְאָמַר אֲבִי הַֽנַּעַרָה אֶל-הַזְּקֵנִים אֶת-בִּתִּי, נָתַתִּי לָאִישׁ הַזֶּה לְאִשָּׁה--וַיִּשְׂנָאֶהָ וְהִנֵּה-הוּא שָׂם עֲלִילֹת דְּבָרִים לֵאמֹר לֹֽא-מָצָאתִי לְבִתְּךָ בְּתוּלִים וְאֵלֶּה בְּתוּלֵי בִתִּי וּפָֽרְשׂוּ הַשִּׂמְלָה לִפְנֵי זִקְנֵי הָעִֽיר
he.speaker: אָמַר אֲבִי הַנַּעֲרָ, אֶל-הַזְּקֵנִים: אֶת-בִּתִּי, נָתַתִּי לָאִישׁ הַזֶּה לְאִשָּׁה--וַיִּשְׂנָאֶהָ
